reason: $59 a month is a lot on our budget when we work shifts and can't promise to show up enough to get our money's worth. The library and church playdates are free, so I'd need a real reason to pay.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Ages 8 months to 5 in one room worries me, and I'd be paying $59 for it.
would_change_my_mind: A separate, gated baby area or set toddler-only hours, plus a no-commitment way to try it, like a free first visit or a drop-in around $8.
